Future With Present Continuous, Be Going To, and Will
When describing the future, we use three main structures: Present Continuous, be going to, and will.

1. Present Continuous

    Form: be + verb + -ing

    Use: We use the present continuous to talk about future arrangements that have already been made. We normally use them with a time expression.

    Example:
    • The party is taking place at the Grand Hall on Saturday, Dec 18th.
    • Farmani is covering the champagne.

  2. Be going to

    Form: be + going to + verb

    Use: We use the structure “be going to” to talk about plans, intentions, and decisions about the future.

    Example:
    • Mark Ronson is going to host the event on Saturday.
    • Bryan Adams is going to play at the event.

    Note: Be going to is more common in spoken English than in written English.

  3. Will

    Form: Will + verb

    Use: You use will to talk about actions or events in the future that you think of as facts.

    Example:
    • This event will be successful!
    • A cheese and wine reception will be followed by a fruit and chocolate fondue.
Language used for writing party / event invitations

A party invitation is a letter communicating to people that you want them to attend an event. A good invitation needs to contain all the necessary language and information about the party. Here are some expressions and language you can use when writing a party invitation.

Dear colleagues,

You are all invited to Holly's Grand Gala on Friday, November 16th at 8:00 p.m.
The event is taking place at Rafael's, the old Central Train Station, located at 1600 Queen's Blvd.

This will coincide with our other event in Sao Paulo that is occurring during their renowned Fashion Week. The events are going to be broadcast simultaneously. Ricardo Verde is going to host the event and “1WayToHeaven” is going to play.

A cheese and wine reception will be followed by a fruit and chocolate fondue. Farmani is covering champagne for all our employees.

Transportation: Rafael's is conveniently located by the Queen's Blvd subway station. Bicycle stands are beside the entrance and there is a small parking lot on the east side of the building. Valet service is available for a fee. There is parking on the side streets west of the station. Parking meters are free after 6:00 pm. William's Limousine service must be contacted a week in advance for reservations. For those involved in setup prior to the event, there will be shuttle service from Polygon at 5:30 and 6:30.

Please RSVP by this Friday, November 9th. This will be a fun event. Don't miss it!

Yours, Miranda
